name: live-touched-josm-plugin
description: JOSM plugin for live touched. Built with Gradle in Docker (no local Java needed).

scripts.josm-build: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/home/gradle/project -w /home/gradle/project -v live-touched-gradle:/home/gradle/.gradle gradle:8.14-jdk21 gradle --no-daemon build
scripts.josm-clean: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/home/gradle/project -w /home/gradle/project -v live-touched-gradle:/home/gradle/.gradle gradle:8.14-jdk21 gradle --no-daemon clean
scripts.josm-install: bun run josm-build && mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/JOSM/plugins" && cp build/dist/live-touched.jar "$HOME/Library/JOSM/plugins/live-touched.jar" && echo "Installed to ~/Library/JOSM/plugins/live-touched.jar"
